project.name: SignalR Desktop Notification App
project.description: A desktop application that uses SignalR to receive real-time notifications.
features: API connectivity to fetch data from a server on event trigger
User interface to display latest details of an event
Background service to listen for events even when the app is minimized
Exit functionality to close the application
Error handling for API connectivity issues
Force pull to update the latest details of an event
Reconnect functionality to handle SignalR connection drops
Reconnect button to manually trigger reconnection attempts
SignalR connection status indicator to show current connection state
